options.name: authoritative_existing_vector_wordmark
requirements: trusted SVG, PDF, AI, or vector export
human confirmation that the source represents the intended wordmark

options.name: controlled_typographic_wordmark
requirements: documented font name, version, license, provenance, source, and fallback status
live-text review mock before any approved outline conversion
no committed or vendored font files

options.name: human_designed_custom_wordmark
requirements: reviewed vector source with authorship, rights, and provenance

options.name: temporary_layout_mock
requirements: clearly marked non-final, placeholder, and review-only
not eligible to become a master or approval candidate

risks: whole-image tracing can drift letter geometry
segmentation can drift kerning and spacing
antialiasing thresholds can change letterforms and counters
morphological cleanup and Potrace smoothing can alter terminals, joins, counters, and curves
a source raster is not an authoritative wordmark master
whole-lockup tracing would recreate rather than reuse the locked symbol geometry
prohibited_actions: create or present a final wordmark master
create light or dark lockup candidates
redraw, retrace, or alter the locked symbol
silently replace the wordmark with a system font
commit or vendor font files or proprietary font binaries
use a font without documented license and provenance
create runtime or public assets, exports, favicons, app icons, CSS, or website integration
next_steps: request and audit an authoritative vector wordmark source
if unavailable, separately specify a review-only controlled typographic mock with documented font provenance and license
obtain explicit human direction before preparing any wordmark or lockup candidate
